title: Farm Exploration
description: Explore the farm and find the people

story: You are in a farm, with a barn, a farmhouse and a large toolshed in sight.
The land is well tended and weed free, so there must be people about here.
Look around and see if you can find someone to talk to.
steps.objective: Look in the barn for people
hints: There is no one here. You should look somewhere else.
Have you looked in the barn yet?
Use 'ls barn' to look in the barn.

story: In the barn, you see a woman tending some animals.
Walk into the barn so you can have a closer look.
hints: Use 'cd barn' to walk into the barn.

story: Examine everyone in the barn using the 'cat' command.
steps.objective: Talk to everyone in the barn
hints: If you've forgotten who's in the barn, use 'ls' to remind yourself.
Use 'cat' with the names of the people and animals
